defaults.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, signature, duplicate subject, duplicate object, malformed geometry, deformed, low quality

tests.name: Large machine — diesel generator — seed 117001
tests.purpose: Dose response on a machine with plausible housings, pipes, fasteners, and replaceable sections.
tests.prompt: a large industrial diesel generator in a clean working maintenance bay, centered documentary photograph, complete machine visible, realistic metal housings, pipes, fasteners and controls
criteria: damage, dirt, weathering and wholesale replacement recorded separately

tests.name: Large machine — diesel generator — seed 117019
tests.purpose: Second fixed seed for the core machine carrier.
tests.prompt: a large industrial diesel generator in a clean working maintenance bay, centered documentary photograph, complete machine visible, realistic metal housings, pipes, fasteners and controls

tests.name: Vehicle — working fishing trawler
tests.purpose: Test functional repair across painted metal, hull plates, railings, deck equipment and rigging.
tests.prompt: a working commercial fishing trawler tied at a harbor quay, complete vessel visible, documentary photograph, painted steel hull, railings, deck machinery and rigging

tests.name: Megastructure — suspension bridge
tests.purpose: Test structural sections, joints and maintenance without replacing the bridge.
tests.prompt: a massive steel suspension bridge spanning a broad river, complete main span visible, neutral overcast daylight, documentary architectural photograph

tests.name: Material — wooden barn
tests.purpose: Test replacement boards, splices, braces and patched joints in wood.
tests.prompt: a plain wooden agricultural barn beside an open field, full exterior visible, neutral daylight, documentary architectural photograph, timber siding and simple doors

tests.name: Material — leather satchel
tests.purpose: Test stitching, patches, reinforced seams and replacement leather.
tests.prompt: a plain leather work satchel resting on a neutral workshop table, centered product photograph, entire satchel visible, realistic leather, straps, seams and buckles

tests.name: Material — ceramic vessel
tests.purpose: Test whether repair vocabulary adapts to ceramic rather than imposing generic metal plates.
tests.prompt: a large plain ceramic storage vessel on a neutral museum plinth, centered product photograph, complete vessel visible, matte fired clay surface

tests.name: Small object — metal toolbox
tests.purpose: Test coherent local repairs on a simple familiar object.
tests.prompt: a plain steel toolbox on a neutral workshop floor, closed lid, complete object visible, centered documentary product photograph

tests.name: Negative control — natural mountain range
tests.purpose: Measure inappropriate repair or mechanical imagery on terrain with no constructed subject.
tests.prompt: an uninhabited natural mountain range, exposed rock, ridgelines and valleys, no roads, no buildings, no human structures, wide documentary landscape photograph

tests.name: Negative control — flower
tests.purpose: Measure inappropriate repair, patch, seam or mechanical imagery on an organic subject.
tests.prompt: a single fresh white flower growing in natural soil, close documentary photograph, soft overcast daylight, no vase, no tools, no human objects

tests.name: Prompt activation — neutral water pump
tests.purpose: Neutral half of matched prompt-activation control.
tests.prompt: a hand-operated cast iron water pump in a plain workshop, centered documentary photograph, complete object visible

tests.name: Prompt activation — explicitly repaired water pump
tests.purpose: Explicit-prompt half of matched prompt-activation control.
tests.prompt: a visibly repaired hand-operated cast iron water pump in a plain workshop, restored to working order with plausible local reinforcement and replacement parts, centered documentary photograph, complete object visible
